board_result_sha256.principle: The board-side result hash compared against the CPU reference -- auditable provenance that the workload ran on the board.

cpu_reference_sha256.principle: The local reference result hash compared against the board result -- auditable provenance for the deterministic CPU baseline.

honest_verdict.principle: Terminal prefix records whether the live board run succeeded, completed with non-terminal evidence, or stopped at a precondition.

inference_substrate.principle: Inference-Substrate declaration for a hardware_smoke SSH-attached board run.

polarfire_workload_validated.principle: Bare bool -- terminal-state gate; true only if the board's result hash matches the CPU reference and the real dispatch duration reaches the floor.

preconditions_checked.principle: Pre-Launch + Inference-Substrate hardware_smoke gate; SSH reachability and board Python checks must pass before dispatch.

random_seed.principle: Pre-Launch reproducibility field controlling the fixed Ising workload.

reproducibility_checksum.principle: Content-addressed checksum over the artifact, excluding this checksum, so later drift is detectable.

result_hash_match.principle: Bare bool -- the structural anti-fabrication check; the board must reproduce the exact reference result.

run_duration_s.principle: Real SSH round-trip wall-clock; >=5s floor structurally prevents the exp1680 run_duration_s=0 fabrication.

soc_temp_max_c.principle: Per-board hardware-artifact thermal field; null only when the board does not expose readable thermal sysfs values.

thermal_note.principle: Per-board hardware-artifact field describing the passive-cooling envelope of the dispatch.
